1|## Chapter 50 — The Ceres Proposal
     2|
     3|*Mission AI: "Your grandparents feared isolation in the belt. You fear the loneliness of being seen as a waystation."*  
     4|*Ambassador Elias Navarro VIII: "We're not just a rock between worlds. We are a world in our own right."*
     5|
     6|The alert came not as a crisis siren, but as a diplomatic pulse: Proposal Received - Ceres Colonial Authority, Initiative Alpha-Omega. Ambassador Elias Navarro VIII adjusted his spectacles, the familiar weight of decades spent in recycled air and even more decades spent knowing how proposals actually form in the outer reaches, as he looked at the notification flashing across his console in the Valles Marineris Diplomatic Corps' strategic initiatives chamber.
     7|
     8|"Mission AI," he said, his voice carrying the rasp of years spent in treaty negotiations and the quiet focus of generational expertise, "confirm the nature of this proposal."
